conventions.execution: decision after the close of day t with data up to t, execution at the close of t+1; an order without a price on its execution day is rejected, not carried over
conventions.valuation: value = cash + shares x last known raw close; a missing close is never interpolated, the position keeps its last price
conventions.costs: proportional cost of 5 basis points of the amount traded; paid in cash, target weights are fractions of the value net of costs
conventions.cash: cash earns the simple rate given for each period, applied to the balance of the previous close; no borrowing: purchases are scaled down to the cash available
conventions.corporate_actions: splits multiply the shares and dividends are credited in cash, both on their effective date and before any execution of that day
conventions.turnover: half the amount traded over the portfolio value at execution; cash is not counted as an asset
conventions.strategy: minimum variance, Ledoit-Wolf (2004) covariance, estimated on the 252 daily returns that end on the decision day, each weight between 0 % and 50 %, rebalanced on the first day of each month; held: the assets quoted on every day of the window and in the universe on the decision day

descriptions: minimum variance, Ledoit-Wolf (2004) covariance, estimated on the 63 daily returns that end on the decision day, each weight between 0 % and 100 %, rebalanced on the first day of each month; held: the assets quoted on every day of the window and in the universe on the decision day
